name: spo-list-formatting
title: Export / Import list formatting
shortDescription: Export and import SharePoint list formatting (column formatting, view formatting, form customizers) using PnP PowerShell or CLI for Microsoft 365
longDescription: Export and import SharePoint list formatting (column formatting, view formatting, form customizers) using PnP PowerShell or CLI for Microsoft 365. Bridges the gap in PnP provisioning where Get-PnPSiteTemplate does not export list formatting customizations.
